description:
I'm an Automation & Robotics Engineer interested in AI, computer vision, robotics, and autonomous navigation. I have experience with Python, YOLOv8, machine learning, and robotics simulation.

For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, I'm tackling "Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map." I aim to build an interactive Mars map using NASA data to visualize terrain, identify hazards, and plan safer routes. I'll develop a functional, user-friendly solution independently.
